name: okf
description: Open Knowledge Format skills for standard Markdown bundles and the opt-in okf-adoc/1.0 profile.

interface.shortDescription: Write and read OKF knowledge bundles
interface.longDescription: Use okf-generate and okf-consume for standard Markdown-only OKF v0.3 bundles. Use okf-generate-adoc and okf-consume-adoc for explicitly selected okf-adoc/1.0 bundles. Both pairs preserve provenance, trust, freshness, and attestation distinctions.
defaultPrompt: Write an OKF bundle that documents this dataset.
Answer from this OKF bundle and report the trust of each concept.
